newsitem.title: USA: Playskool to recall, repair high chairs.
newsitem.headline: Playskool to recall, repair high chairs.

text.p: Hasbro Inc.'s Playskool division will recall and repair the restraint bars of 287,00 of its 1-2-3 High Chairs, the U.S. Consumer Products Safety Commission said Monday.
The CPSC said the restraint bar can crack or break off, which may allow a child who is not secured with the accompanying seat belt to fall from the chair and be injured.

Playskool had received hundreds of complaints of cracking and breaking restraint bars and 40 reports of injuries to children falling off the high chairs. Most injuries were minor, although one child broke its collarbone, CPSC said.
The plastic restraint bar is located at the center of the front of the seat and the high chair's tray attaches to it.
Only restraint bars on high chairs made between May 1995 and May 1996 require replacement and the chairs have serial numbers between TX51321 and TX61442.
The Playskool 1-2-3 High Chair is available nationwide at discount juvenile product and department stores for about $65.
The company said consumers wishing to receive a free replacement restraint bar could call Playskool at 1-800-555-0428 or write to the company at P.O. Box 5659, Pawtucket, RI 02862.
Playskool and CPSC reminded consumers that children shoul always wear seat belts when sitting in any high chair.
